evals.name: logo-no-output-path
evals.prompt: Make me a logo for my coffee shop called Ember & Oak — warm and minimal, something I can use on the website header. Save it somewhere in my project.
evals.expected_output: A square-ish PNG logo with a warm, minimal aesthetic, written to a sensible absolute path the agent chose (e.g. an assets/ dir). The skill must pick an output path even though the user didn't give an exact one, and the file must exist there.

evals.name: hero-explicit-path-and-style
evals.prompt: I need a hero image for my meditation app landing page. Calm and serene, soft pastel gradients, lots of negative space, no text. Save it to /tmp/image-generation-test/meditation_hero.png
evals.expected_output: A landscape PNG at exactly /tmp/image-generation-test/meditation_hero.png that reflects the calm/serene/pastel-gradient brief with no baked-in text.

evals.name: edit-with-reference
evals.prompt: Take this mascot image and restyle it as a glossy 3D render while keeping the same pose and friendly expression. Reference: /tmp/image-generation-test/test_mascot.png. Save the result to /tmp/image-generation-test/mascot_3d.png
evals.expected_output: A PNG at /tmp/image-generation-test/mascot_3d.png that is recognizably the same mascot/pose from the reference but rendered in a glossy 3D style. The skill must pass the reference via --reference.
